satellites.title: Earth as a Phase
satellites.evidence: 洪範 lists 土 fifth among five phases. This symbolic 土 is not a scientific statement about the planet.
satellites.caveat: A correspondence internal to a historical system; not a statement about natural science.

satellites.title: Earth Is Sowing and Reaping
satellites.evidence: The Hongfan names each phase by what it does: 水曰潤下，火曰炎上，木曰曲直，金曰從革，土爰稼穡 — water soaks downward, fire flames upward, wood bends and straightens, metal yields and is reshaped, and earth is where sowing and reaping happen.
satellites.caveat: Only Earth takes 爰 rather than 曰; commentators have read the change as setting Earth apart. Baracus’s, from general knowledge.
